 KPop Demon Hunters world tour coming to Chicago in 2027
 WGN Chicago Follow Alonzo Small Add to Preferred Sources Fri, November 13, 2026 at 8:55 PM UTC KPop Demon Hunters world tour coming to Chicago in 2027 CHICAGO ( WGN ) — Get ready to sing 'Golden' at the top of your lungs: The KPop Demon Hunters' world tour is coming to Chicago.
 Launching in the summer of 2027, the tour follows the animated HUNTR/X characters—Rumi, Mira, and Zoey—as they interact with the audience through a cutting-edge K-pop concert experience unlike anything fans have seen, heard, or felt before.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Chicago's United Center will host two shows on Saturday, June 19, 2027.
 FILE - Audrey Nuna, from left, Ejae, and Rei Ami from "KPop Demon Hunters" appear at the MTV Video Music Awards in Elmont, N.Y., on Sept. 7, 2025. (Photo by Evan Agostini/Invision/AP, File)
 Tickets go on sale to the general public Friday, Nov. 20 at 10 a.m. local time. A limited number of exclusive VIP experiences and packages will be available.
 For more information: www.kpopdemonhunterstour.com 
 Netflix says KPop Demon Hunters is the streaming platform's most popular film of all time. Its breakout song "Golden" became the first K-pop record to win both an Oscar and a Grammy.
